column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Papal Coup and Rupirupi's Sacrifice
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: W-what the hell is going on!?
$$マモン$$ and that lovesick lady aside,
why are you here too!?
Heh heh heh heh...
You filthy white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s—don't you dare speak so casually to us!!
You do not know this, but...
right now, on the ground, the white-$$羽$$ underground movement
has recklessly launched a massive revolution against the black-$$羽$$ army!!
Heh heh heh...
without realizing that all their battle plans have already been exposed to the $$教団$$!
No!
The ones who walked into the ambush should be wiped out by now!
B-but why?
How could...
Mr. $$ケルビム$$, who was always so kind!?
Do not call my name with that filthy mouth!!
You...
You filthy white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s...
drove my son and my family to ruin!!
Ever since my son $$セラフィム$$ died,
I have long awaited the chance to avenge this grudge...
That is why I deliberately rebuilt that secret underground organization!!
Wh-why go through so much trouble!?
Then why not just wipe us white-$$羽$$s out from the start!?
Hee hee hee... That would put us in a bind!
In every age, society has always been...
a structure where a small number of rulers exploit a great many $$弱者$$.
In other words, if the people being exploited disappeared,
we, the exploiters, would be in trouble too!!
Neither let them live nor kill them—let us all get along!
After all, a black-$$羽$$ world exists only thanks to white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s!!
I-is that all you wanted to say!?
My, my, so worked up. I can hear you!
Even though you are not really that strong!
Are you hurt, $$お師匠様$$...?
Cough, cough... hack...
I am all right. You worry about yourself!!
Even if I die, I will never leave my $$お師匠様$$!!
Aaaaaaargh!!
Still putting on that sickening little love play, I see!!
But that woman is merely descended from talking $$オサル$$s!
And what of it...?!
Other than lifespan and magical power...
what difference is there between us $$大天使$$s and them!?
At the root of it all...
are they not both children of God, created by the Creator!?
My, my...
Is that difference alone not quite enough!?
Besides, you too have become quite steeped in the teachings of $$邪教の教え$$...
I was even thinking I would spare your life if you joined our side...!?
The diversion ends here!
Apostles of the $$大邪神$$, be crushed in this barrier as in the $$創世記戦争$$...
and perish from this Heaven!!
Aaaaaaah!!
G-ghaaaaaah!!
Damn you, $$バアル$$!!
Gwaaaaaaah!!
Aaaaaaah!!
I-I cannot... Aaaaaah!!
Ghh... I cannot hold out... Gah!!
We cannot go on like this!
Everyone... everyone will die...!
I have to save everyone somehow!!
Armor, please!
I will give you... all my life!!
W-what are you doing, $$ルピルピ$$!?
R-$$ルピルピ$$!!
Stop it!!
My knowledge...
will always be with my $$お師匠様$$... t-o-g-e-t-h-e-r...
Enough, enough, $$ルピルピ$$...
Because I rushed to break the $$封印$$ on that one's soul, sleeping in $$メタトロン$$'s armor...
Old man... $$ルピルピ$$ is...
$$ルピルピ$$ is here... She will always be with me...
Everyone!!
They are probably in the grand hall above...
But by now, the 72 generals who served the six $$大天使$$s must be guarding this mansion!!
Be on your guard...!
(I will not forgive you... I will not forgive you...)
